answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 36472 Country: India Title: changing clothes naked in room alone Question: My question is that if a person is alone and he comes out of bathroom in towel after taking bath and enters in room and locks the room. No one is there in the room then he takes out his towel and is completely naked now then he starts putting on new clothes one by one. So is this the way of changing clothes allowed and is his wudhu and bath valid now. If not then what is the Islamic way of changing clothes. Answer ID: 36472 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 301/111/L=1433) It is not right to change one's clothes though alone in the room by going naked completely. One should feel shy of Allah. However, wudhu and ghusl shall remain intact and shall not be invalid. One should take care while changing clothes in the room alone that the part below the navel to knee (satr) is not opened. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
